answer: Berth access at the harbor is auctioned once per epoch: each identity may lock a bid, and only the winning slot can work. The bid must sit in a hollow time-lock for 18 hours, and two established raters must post a yarrow witness that the bidder's custody root has no other live bid in any adjacent harbor. If a later bid shares a custody root or a 10-bit ticket prefix, both hollow locks are slashed 80% and those roots are barred from the next three auctions. Each rater may witness at most two yarrow bids per day.
